# Vectors: payload-constructed

Guideline baseline: `2bfc0d9` · Kind: payload · 7 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

Constructed payload vectors for the two validation modes of MG 8 (SF-052): strict validation reports every key that is not defined for the object (REQ-MSG-001, conformance of the sender), tolerant validation ignores such keys (REQ-MSG-046, view of a tolerant receiver). Without mode a vector is checked strictly. Since C-027 also invalid variants of golden vectors that each violate one rule of the resource content checks (Health, Pagination, MAM, PublicationList).
